component.name: MD Lite
component.summary: A little space to read — and write
Un pequeño espacio para leer y escribir

description.p: MD Lite is a lightweight, native Markdown reader and editor. It renders GitHub Flavored Markdown the way GitHub does — tables, task lists, alerts, raw HTML from real READMEs and Mermaid diagrams — and lets you write with the formatting in view.

MD Lite es un lector y editor de Markdown nativo y ligero. Muestra GitHub Flavored Markdown como GitHub — tablas, listas de tareas, alertas, el HTML de los README reales y diagramas Mermaid — y te deja escribir con el formato a la vista.

ul.li: Reading, Editor, Source and Split modes
Tabs, two side-by-side panes and working folders
Files save themselves as you type
Remote images stay blocked until you ask for them

screenshot.caption: Writing with the formatting in view

description.p: Version in step with the macOS release.
Version in step with the macOS release.
The native GTK 4 app gets a release of its own. Checking a task in the reading view no longer freezes the app.
First native GTK 4 release for Linux.
